reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I already have a reason to try one. Named independent lab and a report per batch is the first time a supplement ad actually answers my 'is it tested' question, and the empty-box refund makes one box low risk at the launch price.
objection: A lab report only shows what is in the capsule, not that magnesium will do anything for me. I would also want to confirm with my doctor what dose I need before taking 200 mg every day.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the product page turned out to be missing, vague, or from a lab I can't look up, I would not buy.
